# Security Officer Ensuring the safety of both station and crew is number one for [color=#cb0000]Security[/color]. They start ready for any situation, and are on hand to maintain order and do general deductive work.
They face other organizations, like [textlink="traitors" link="Traitor"], as well as unruly [textlink="crew" link="Crew"]--though nothing is stopping other officers from being the traitors or unruly crew.
As a Security Officer, it would do you well to familiarize yourself with the many [textlink="masks" link="OrganizationsAndSecretIdentities"] in the game, and understand what excuses someone may use and when, in order to make the most accurate deduction.
## Gear First we have less lethal options--a step above simply telling someone to cooperate with instructions. Blackjacks can be used to incapacitate targets at close range, and handcuffs can be applied to deny a criminal free movement and access to their hands. Cuffs will also shove the person down if your [color=red]harm mode[/color] is active during uncuff.
## Firearms [color=#a4885c]Pistols[/color] are an essential part of security, dealing quick, ranged damage to those deemed true enemies to the station. With enough shots, you can down someone into a partially critical state much like with [color=#a4885c]Blackjacks[/color], they will still be able to crawl when not being attacked further but are much more limited. Ammo is limited and deaths are permanent, so be wise lest the crew decide you are a traitor and cut you down just as quick.
